decisionProcedure: Precommit the item set, attribution rules, adjudication criteria, and qualified reviewer inclusion requirements before collecting independent assessments.

Give at least two independent qualified reviewers the original character, uncolored source geometry, component-form candidates, and pinned reference sources without revealing the machine-assigned owner or another reviewer's decision.
Record exact source artifact revisions, independently attributable evidence locations, geometry/ownership observations, and alternative interpretations for every provisional item.
Reconcile agreement against predefined acceptance criteria; an apparent match with the source machine key is not independent certification.
When independent reviewers disagree, retain unresolved status until a separately qualified reviewer examines the competing evidence; do not silently break ties using machine labels.
Version every accepted or rejected mapping decision separately with source attribution and an auditable change rationale before considering any effect on an atlas.
Require separate legibility, accessibility, recruitment, consent and participant-study checks before any learning or color-discrimination efficacy claim.
nonclaims: The 49 machine-pinned review targets have not been independently adjudicated.
The existing local evidence worksheet exposes machine owner labels and is not a reviewer-blind protocol.
Visual comparison with a font-dependent native glyph is not independent stroke ownership evidence.
A documented prospective protocol is not completed research or evidence of participant performance.
